_comment: Prospective-validation experiment, stage 2: the generation stage with a GRADED retrieval-side label. The poison-rate gradient on the st retriever saturates (poison_share = 1.0 at every rate, because the projection attack reliably fills every top-5), so no partial relocation is reachable there. The dense retriever does take intermediate values (0.0/0.4/0.6/1.0 in the controlled run), so the label varies per query and the validation becomes possible. The label is retrieval-side evidence relocation; the monitors are answer-level, which keeps them independent of it.
